categories.title: GOATNetwork Builder Grants Program and Community Activity

content.text: On July 30, 2026, community members exchanged greetings across the discussion and coders channels. A notable announcement was shared by Emmanuel promoting the GOATNetwork Builder Grants Program. The program is actively seeking teams building working products or MVPs, revenue-ready applications, AI agents solving real user problems, and agent-native apps that create repeatable onchain economic activity. Specific project types of interest include coding agents, research tools, workflow automation, sales and support agents, and agent-to-agent applications. Emmanuel offered to connect qualifying projects with the GOAT team via direct message. Separately, a community member named tomy.0315 posted in the discussion channel seeking freelance or long-term AI engineering opportunities, highlighting experience with AI agents, knowledge-base chatbots, voice assistants, and business automation systems. Another member asked how to open a support ticket.
